availability: Production server is not configured. Offline racing is available.
release_notes: Mobile rendering repairs: one bounded render target, no transient MSAA allocation, no singular unused skid instances, and Android GPU binary-cache reuse disabled.
A safe Low / 30 FPS Android profile is adopted once without clearing player progress, controls or audio preferences. Medium/High remain available with graphics recovery and timed confirmation.

Expanded native fullscreen aspect, safe-area menus, brighter glass pedals and a detailed virtual steering wheel. Original cars, maps, shaders and shared 120 Hz steering/braking/drift physics are retained.
Real-stage startup/race loading, bounded mobile car caching, permanent collision shapes with discarded hidden source meshes, and camera-frustum scenery culling.
RSA-signed release and server manifests, separate Production/Development/Custom server selection, bounded retry and clear offline/DNS/TLS errors.
Signed, SHA-256 verified, data-only image content updates activate at menus, preserve previous verified content, reject scripts, and clean obsolete cache files safely.
Android and Windows update notices show version, notes and download size; installation uses the normal Android installer or a new Windows folder.
Local development gateway multiplayer and security/graphics regression tests are executed; public multiplayer hosting is not configured.
Development preview: final physical Android testing is unavailable. Medium/High device rendering and phone/Windows crossplay are not certified.
limitations: Physical Android installation testing remains incomplete.
Physical Android + Windows multiplayer testing remains incomplete.
Physical Android Low/Medium/High graphics qualification remains incomplete.
Final Android Low/Medium/High rendering, touch, lifecycle and phone/Windows cross-play remain unverified; the earlier POCO evidence is from a different candidate.
Public multiplayer is not configured. The isolated development server is available locally; public tunnel launch was blocked by automatic approval review.
Automatic content updates currently support allowlisted images. New map geometry, audio and application code use complete APK/Windows packages.
